description: Query Databuddy's analytics API (www.databuddy.cc/docs/api) for a website: one query or a batch of 2-10. Query types come from capabilities. Default range last_30d. Returns at most 20 rows per query.

filters.description: Filters [{field, op, value}]. ops: eq, ne, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, in, not_in, regex, not_regex (re2), gt, gte, lt, lte (numeric), is_set, is_not_set (value ignored). 'field' must be in the query type's allowedFilters (capabilities detail='full'): properties.<key> (e.g. properties.plan) filters by a custom event or page view property where listed, and trait:<key> (e.g. trait:plan) segments by an identified-user trait. Rejected fields return the allowed list for this query.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1-20. Defaults to the query type's own limit; at most 20 rows are returned.

orderBy.description: Output metric to sort by, such as 'visitors' or 'pageviews DESC'. Rejected values return the allowed list.

queries.description: Batch mode: 2-10 query items, each with type and optionally its own preset or from/to. Items without a date range use the top-level preset or from/to, and items inherit the top-level timeUnit, limit, filters, and orderBy unless they set their own. Omit 'type' when using this.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1-20. Defaults to the query type's own limit; at most 20 rows are returned.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for date presets and date or hour buckets. Defaults to UTC. Row timestamps such as time, first_visit, or last_visit are returned in UTC.

type.description: Query type for single-query mode. Use capabilities to see all types.

name: get_data
title: Query analytics
